column1: # SquachWatch — two-slot partition table for the 16 MB boards (the NM-CYD-C5
# first; the M5Stack Tab5 uses it too).
# Same shape and the same reasoning as partitions_ota.csv
# replace: that table is correct for the 4 MB classic CYD and every Xtensa board
# keeps using it. This one exists only because the C5 carries 16 MB
# table on a 16 MB part wastes three quarters of the flash while still forcing
# the app to fit in 1.9 MB.
# nvs and otadata keep the EXACT offsets and sizes the 4 MB table uses
# (0x9000/0x5000 and 0xe000/0x2000). That is deliberate and it is the whole
# reason a board's settings
# survive a table change: the bootloader and NVS find them in the same place
# either way. Do not "tidy" these two lines.
# App slots are 6 MB each against a ~1.5 MB image
# than the Xtensa boards get. That is not generosity
